evidence.quote: Right now, the 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro with 36 GB of RAM and 2 TB of storage is $3,499, which is 20 percent off the retail price

claims.claim: Mevcut indirimli fiyat, birkaç gün önceki fiyatından 400 dolar daha ucuzdur.

evidence.quote: Right now, the 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro with 36 GB of RAM and 2 TB of storage is $3,499, which is 20 percent off the retail price and $400 cheaper than it was just a few days ago.

claims.claim: Cyberpunk 2077 oyunu, Ultra ön ayarında ve ölçeklendirme olmadan ortalama 60 kareden fazla saniyede hız sunabilmektedir.

evidence.quote: In my testing, Cyberpunk 2077 could average over 60 frame per second on the Ultra preset without relying on upscaling.

evidence.quote: If you really want to get serious about AI performance, you'll want to upgrade to the 64-GB or 128-GB configurations—though third-party retailers like Amazon don't sell them.
